summary: HQ / ownership: San Mateo, CA; private (Presto Phoenix, Inc.) after a 2024 Nasdaq delisting and lender-led restructuring; $10M raised Jan 8, 2026 (led by Metropolitan Partners Group; Remus Capital, Link Ventures, angels incl. the ElevenLabs CEO)
Scale: "hundreds of drive-thrus," "a dozen enterprise QSR brands" (company claim)
Enterprise drive-thru voice AI; spun off tabletop to focus on voice

Joined the Toast partner ecosystem Sep 21, 2026, so voice orders now flow into Toast POS/KDS — "we're committed to integration partners who can help customers build the tech stacks they need" (Justin Graham, VP, Toast)
Past CKE upsell results: "significant rise in revenue due to the upsell capability" (Phil Crawford, CKE CTO, 2023)

**SEC cease-and-desist (Jan 14, 2025):** Presto made "materially false and misleading statements" about Presto Voice; "the vast majority of drive-thru orders placed through this version of Presto Voice required human intervention" (Nov 2021–May 2023). No civil penalty, citing cooperation
CKE (a past Presto customer) signed Genius as its exclusive POS with "end-to-end drive-thru technology" (May 2026); Presto's status at CKE after that is not found
Krishna Gupta — CEO / co-founder: "Restaurants are increasingly looking for scalable, AI-driven solutions"
Volatility: delisting, restructuring and an SEC action within ~2 years
Small recent raise ($10M); financials not disclosed
Carl's Jr. / Hardee's (named in Jan 2026 coverage)
Presto announced a Toast integration for drive-thru voice automation in September 2026. (Scope note: Announcement does not quantify completed Toast-integrated drive-thru deployments.)

Presto announced co-founder Krishna Gupta returned as CEO in April 2026. (Scope note: Role current as represented by the linked company source on access date; recheck for subsequent leadership changes.)
